items.title: Albert "Baby Brousse" Broussard Interview, 1961-02-20
items.q: He used to live on St. Peter... Right next door to us... Frank Carbone. And he really played nice trumpet.

ctx.x: Did you mention Carbone did you say?
Yeah, Carbone. We used to call him Kev. Frank Carbone. It was a nickname that we gave him. His name was Frank Thomas, see? But we called him Frank Carbone. Oh, yeah.
You talk about Big Bill's brother? Big Bill's brother.
